scope: The protein content of thawed sputum supernatants was determined. Per sample, 5µg of protein was reduced, alkylated, digested, and cleaned up by an Auto-SP3 protocol and analyzed by an Ultimate 3000 HPLC-Orbitrap Exploris 480 mass spectrometer in data-independent mode.
A total of 1,495 proteins were identified and quantified across sputum supernatants from healthy individuals, CF patients, and COPD patients
